title: 宠物机 XIAO 直插承载板

GND.rationale: Active-low switch to ground; XIAO internal pullup, firmware debounce 20 ms.

KEY_LEFT.rationale: Active-low switch to ground; XIAO internal pullup, firmware debounce 20 ms.

KEY_MID.rationale: Active-low switch to ground; XIAO internal pullup, firmware debounce 20 ms.

KEY_RIGHT.rationale: Active-low switch to ground; XIAO internal pullup, firmware debounce 20 ms.

LCD_SCK.rationale: Dedicated hardware SPI clock from XIAO D8/GPIO7 to 7P ST7789, no CS on selected screen.

LCD_DATA.rationale: Existing display serial data from XIAO D10/GPIO9.

V3V3.rationale: Pass-through XIAO regulated 3.3 V to display, no supply conversion. Reserve 0.5 mm trace; no increase to vendor current capability claimed.

LCD_RES.rationale: 3.3V screen control from XIAO D4/GPIO5; BLK open-drain low-off/high-Z-on, never GPIO LED supply.

LCD_DC.rationale: 3.3V screen control from XIAO D5/GPIO6; BLK open-drain low-off/high-Z-on, never GPIO LED supply.

LCD_BLK.rationale: 3.3V screen control from XIAO D6/GPIO43; BLK open-drain low-off/high-Z-on, never GPIO LED supply.
